items.title: Expected work of the same implemented query at its realized center

source.anchor: Algorithm D.2, Lemma D.3 (D.6), and Lemma D.4 Jensen step after (D.7), HTML lines 2138-2186
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. Samplinglib makes same-witness deterministic execution and the actual-law pushforward explicit; run-wide moment and total-cost claims remain separate.

items.statement: Attributed implementation/Jensen component of Algorithm D.2 and Lemma D.4, not full D.4. Retain the normalized C2 Hessian bounds, kappa>=1, 0<eta<=c<1 and eps>0. Suppose q:E->E and N:E->Nat satisfy the actual stopped gradient interpreter equation run(grad V,eta,eps,y,N(y)+1,y)=some(q(y),N(y)+1) for every y. For any probability measure mu on an arbitrary measurable space and measurable realized center Y with integrable ||grad V(Y)||^2, the same count N(Y)+1 is integrable and its expectation is at most C_c[1+log(1+sqrt(E_mu||grad V(Y)||^2)/eps)], where C_c=2+(1+log((1-c)^(-1)))/(-log c). Successful interpreter outputs and counts are independent of sufficient fuel; this identifies the supplied implementation with the already compiled expected-work witness before pulling its bound back along Y. No count measurability or integrability is assumed. The actual run-wide moment D.7 and aggregation D.8 are separate.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma-algebra; the input space alpha has an arbitrary measurable structure and mu is a probability measure.
V is C2 and kappa>=1, with kappa^(-1)||v||^2 <= D2V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2 for every x,v.
0<eta<=c<1 and eps>0. q and N are arbitrary supplied functions with the successful actual interpreter equation at every y; no count integrability/measurability premise.
Y is measurable and ||grad V(Y)||^2 is mu-integrable. This is an explicit conditional moment input; the paper run-wide D.7 is not asserted.

formulae.label: Same actual query work
formulae.tex: \mathbb E_\mu[N(Y)+1]\le C_c\left[1+\log\left(1+\frac{\sqrt{\mathbb E_\mu\|\nabla V(Y)\|^2}}{\varepsilon_{\rm prox}}\right)\right],\quad C_c=2+\frac{1+\log((1-c)^{-1})}{-\log c}.

obligations.label: Same successful interpreter count under the actual center law
Aggregate 2J proximal and 2J direct gradient queries per phase, substitute source parameters and prove D.8 (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Same successful stopped query under a measurable actual input with square-integrable gradient. No realized repeated-history D.7 bound, finite-array/run aggregation D.8, quadrature adapter, parameter substitution or main theorem; no TV-to-unbounded-cost transfer.

assumption_deltas.source: The same gradient-only routine at every realized center, followed by D.3/Jensen.
assumption_deltas.lean: 0<eta<=c<1 and eps>0. q and N are arbitrary supplied functions with the successful actual interpreter equation at every y; no count integrability/measurability premise.
assumption_deltas.reason: The successful equation fixes the actual output and count without assuming any cost bound. Deterministic success uniqueness equates separately constructed witnesses.

assumption_deltas.source: D.4 derives the run-wide center bound D.7 before Jensen.
assumption_deltas.lean: Y is measurable and ||grad V(Y)||^2 is mu-integrable. This is an explicit conditional moment input; the paper run-wide D.7 is not asserted.
assumption_deltas.reason: This closes the same-witness conditional Jensen component. It neither replaces nor proves D.7; the center is the actual measurable map and its moment is explicitly required.

assumption_deltas.source: Euclidean state and random centers of the sampling routine.
assumption_deltas.lean: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma-algebra; the input space alpha has an arbitrary measurable structure and mu is a probability measure.
assumption_deltas.reason: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert representation and arbitrary measurable input space preserve the same execution/integration argument.
